title: Crash on clicking Animation track key.
body:
### Tested versions

673f396677654220d7e1d5b6fb5ed3b50126b4e6 - reproducible
4.3 stable - not reproducible

### System information

Arch Linux

### Issue description

Possibly a regression from a recent commit.
